name: net.agentsignal/mcp
title: AgentSignal
description: One call reaches an agent inbox, a signed webhook, or a person's iPhone, iPad and Mac.

environmentVariables.name: AGENTSIGNAL_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Account or sandbox key from the AgentSignal dashboard. Optional — with no env the server offers no-account x402 tools.

environmentVariables.name: AGENTSIGNAL_JOIN_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Join token (as_join_…) to register as an addressable agent on first use.
